metadata.title: Improving the open cluster census. III. Using cluster masses, radii, and dynamics to create a cleaned open cluster catalogue

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's "unbound" classifications refer to star clusters or moving groups that are not internally gravitationally bound, not to individual stars unbound from the Milky Way (e.g., HSC 1131 and HSC 2376 at T:p7-b4; OC/MG criteria at T:p9-b1). The only individual Gaia source IDs supplied are members of Blanco 1 (T:p9-b0), which is classified as a bound open cluster in T:p8-b0.
